correctness.rationale: For n>=8, any unit-transfer clique lies in lower D(y) or upper U(z) family. Verified the five corner patches with offset masses 4/5,-1/5,1/15,-1/30 have disjoint clique supports; each local lower perturbation <=0 and each upper perturbation no greater than slack. Explicit rational calculation gives mass 4/15 per corner and objective binom(n+4,4)/5+4/3; known alpha=ceil(binomial/5) yields >=8/15 strict gap. Independently enumerated every lower/upper clique with rational weights at n=8,9,10 (495,715,1001 vertices), but infinite n follows from the patch-support/combinatorial argument, not enumeration.
